=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py:30-70 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The contract test only asserts substrings in the script text, so it does not prove the `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false` path actually exits non-zero.
  WHY: Substring checks can pass even if the conditional is inverted or unreachable, leaving the enforcement path insufficiently verified.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2262-2268 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Exit code 14 is overloaded for both Python version unavailability and renderer execution failures.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish the failure cause from the exit code alone and must inspect the log to tell whether Python or the renderer broke.
- agents.md:184, 196 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES` documentation is duplicated in two locations.
  WHY: Duplicate guidance risks documentation drift if one copy is updated without the other.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:520-533 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The workflow always installs renderer dependencies even when `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false`.
  WHY: An explicit opt-out still pays the dependency-install cost before the script hard-fails.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:123, 1101 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `HARNESS_GENERATOR_MODE` is assigned `"templates"` in two places.
  WHY: Repeating the same hardcoded value is redundant and adds unnecessary maintenance noise.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1151-1152 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The template-mode guard is now dead code because both compared variables are hardcoded to template mode.
  WHY: The condition will never be true in the current architecture, so the branch is unreachable and can be simplified.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
